correctness.rationale: The full exact model and quantifiers are explicit. Determinant factorization yields both thresholds and excludes secondary eigenvalue ambiguity using |det|<1. At no swap and full swap, two-state ergodic time averages give exact almost-sure exponents; at perfect alternation the positive initial component grows by a per period. Interior left Perron weights convert switches to exact multiplication and non-switches to uniform positive bounds, giving an almost-sure exponential-growth lower bound by the switch-count strong law. The rational example is independently recomputed by a standard-library exact checker, but finite checks are not relied on for infinite-time statements. Limitations: linear growth, exogenous Markov environment.

value.rationale: Complete exchange of patches is a natural extremal movement policy. Its viability changes sign under arbitrarily small positive random phase-error frequency, while all strictly interior rates above an explicit threshold retain positive growth near perfect seasonality. The fully rational noisy example isolates a qualitative design vulnerability and robustness distinction that cannot be inferred from just average environment or frozen-state viability. The result is structural and exactly proved; it does not purport to be empirical ecology or an arbitrary parameter substitution.
